data.content_ref: inline:Latent Path Diversification (SRC_001) is compatible with the 'Blind Spot Correlation' (SRC_005) only if the error is a 'shallow' path failure rather than a 'deep' architectural hallucination. This relation is refuted if an adversarial prompt successfully corrects a 'deep' hallucination that is consistent across all latent paths of that specific model architecture.
